text:
QUOTE: `memory_buffer_alloc.c` is a built-in consumer of the runtime hook. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` installs its own calloc/free at lines 570-575 (a mutex-wrapped pair when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the buffer allocator as a consumer of the runtime setter that installs itself from its init function. It does not say "only" in so many words, but it presents the allocator as the one in-tree user.
